messages:
leo_sales: Customer (fed contractor) asked if we can run a sealed-site POC with zero outbound network, physical media transfers, chain-of-custody, and monthly security patches. Also wants pricing options for one-time integration vs reserved nodes. Can we confirm feasibility and risks?
mira_se: Feasible but need clarity on model source (customer-supplied vs our quantized artifact), artifact size, and whether HSM-backed signing is required for the POC.
anil_eng: Implementation idea: produce a signed bundle (bundle.tar.gz + bundle.tar.gz.sig), include SBOM.txt and manifest.json with transfer records. Provide a small verify shim (static binary) that validates signature and appends a local custody log at /var/lib/redwood/custody.log.
claire_ops: Ops note: without egress we cant do remote patch push. We support USB-delta or secure courier patches. Must provide idempotent update scripts, pre-checksums, and a rollback plan. Recommend requiring customer run a local acceptance test before applying patches.
sam_security: Security checklist: FIPS-mode signing for production POCs, signed SBOM, documented key lifecycle, and reproducible-build attestations. For evaluation POCs we can use software signing; production should be HSM-backed.
olga_legal: Legal: if they want notarized custody records we need an addendum. Also clarify export controls on quantized weights and IP ownership in the POC SOW.
leo_sales: For pricing I propose: 60-day technical POC free (3 nodes), $20k one-time packaging & engineering fee for offline integration, then reserved-node annual pricing or per-node annual license. Need to confirm eng day estimates.
mira_se: Est. eng effort: HSM integration 5-10 days, offline updater + acceptance harness 3 days, SBOM/repro builds 2 days. If we do custom model quantization add 4 days.
anil_eng: Upgrade cadence: default quarterly security patches. Monthly critical hotfixes possible with paid support and signed deltas delivered via media. Automatic rollback requires local test harness; we can ship the harness but customer must run it.
claire_ops: Deliverables for POC handoff: pre-transfer checklist, verify commands (sha256sum check, redwood-verify exit codes), runbook for applying deltas, and emergency rollback steps.
sam_security: Ill draft the vendor SQ responses and list any showstoppers. If reproducible-build requirement is strict, that may add time.
leo_sales: Action items: Mira & Anil draft 1-page sealed POC runbook + custody manifest template by Mon EOD. Olga add SOW addendum language. Claire prepare ops checklist. Ill share pricing card.
ticket-bot: poc-ticket-#14177 created, assignees: @mira_se @anil_eng, due: 2026-04-10
leo_sales: flag showstoppers now (HSM lead time, export-control issues). Otherwise proceed to customer sync next week.
